source: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13 (reduction of live loads, pp. 542-543)

sources.influenceMin: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13.1 (p. 542): members with KLL AT of 37.16 m2 or more may be reduced; roof uniform live loads are not reduced by this rule (Sec 2.3.13)
sources.constant: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13.1, Eq 6.2.1 (p. 542): L = L0 (0.25 + 4.57 / sqrt(KLL AT)). The equation is printed in a symbol font that the text layer garbles; its coefficient is three distinct digit glyphs around the point (a.bc), which with the SI form of 15/sqrt(ft2) (15 x 0.3048 = 4.57) confirms 4.57
sources.minOneFloor: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13.1 (p. 542): at least 0.50 L0 for members supporting one floor, 0.40 L0 for two or more
sources.heavyLive: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13.2 (p. 543): live loads over 4.80 kN/m2 are not reduced, except by 20 % on members supporting two or more floors
sources.notReduced: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13.4(a) (p. 543): live loads of 4.80 kN/m2 or less are not reduced in public assembly occupancies
sources.twoFloorsOnly: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13.3 (p. 543): passenger car garages not reduced, except by 20 % on members supporting two or more floors
sources.notReducedBuildings: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13.4(b) (p. 543): no reduction of live loads for cyclone shelters
sources.oneWaySlabWidth: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.13.5 (p. 543): AT of a one-way slab at most the span times 1.5 spans
sources.kll: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Table 6.2.7 (pp. 542-543), live load element factor KLL
sources.roof: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.14.1, Eq 6.2.2 (pp. 543-544): Lr = L0 R1 R2, 0.60 <= Lr <= 1.00; R1 = 1 (AT <= 18.58 m2), 1.2 - 0.011 AT, 0.6 (AT >= 55.74 m2); R2 = 1 (F <= 4), 1.2 - 0.05 F, 0.6 (F >= 12); F = 0.12 x slope in per cent, or 32 x rise / span of an arch or dome. Special purpose roofs (gardens, assembly) follow Sec 2.3.13 (2.3.14.2)
